messages.content: Put the two Sacramento hotel-and-car combinations side by side now. I need the real total, the driving burden, and whether either car can actually be returned if Thursday slips. Do not book anything.

I can do that. To calculate the driving correctly, is Wednesday still the 10:30 a.m. downtown inspection followed by Roseville at 1:30 p.m., with Thursday entirely in Roseville until the airport departure?
Yes. Wednesday downtown should end around noon. I will be in Roseville until about 4:00 Thursday.

The two viable combinations are a downtown stay at Hyatt Regency Sacramento with Enterprise, or a Roseville stay at Courtyard Roseville Galleria Mall with Alamo. The Hyatt is materially easier Wednesday morning; the Courtyard is cheaper overall but requires the Roseville-to-downtown drive before the inspection.
Give me every charge, including tax and parking. Start with downtown.

Hyatt Regency Sacramento is $408.00 for two nights plus $69.36 in estimated room taxes and mandatory fees. Self-parking is $40 nightly, so two parking nights add $80.00. Hotel and parking total $557.36. The Enterprise standard car is $188.72 including airport concession charges and estimated taxes, with unlimited mileage and a full-to-full fuel policy. Estimated fuel for this route is $22.00. There is no separate Wednesday garage charge because the inspection is within walking distance. Lodging, car, parking, and fuel total $768.08. Adding the selected $618 round-trip flight makes the complete trip estimate $1,386.08.
And Roseville.

Courtyard Roseville Galleria Mall is $318.00 for two nights plus $45.46 in estimated room taxes, or $363.46 total. Parking is free. The Alamo standard car is $197.48 including airport fees and estimated taxes, with unlimited mileage and a full-to-full fuel policy. Allow $20.00 for a downtown garage Wednesday and about $29.00 for fuel. That combination totals $609.94 before airfare and $1,227.94 with the $618 flight.
So the suburb saves what, about $160?

Yes. The Courtyard-Alamo combination is $158.14 less than Hyatt-Enterprise on the current estimates. The comparison includes room tax, required hotel fees, all expected parking, rental taxes and airport charges, and estimated fuel. Meals and incidental hotel charges are the only routine items excluded.
What happened to the lowest car quote? It was below both of those.

The $161.30 Ace listing is still visible, but it is not workable for Thursday. Its off-airport desk closes at 5:00 p.m., the location prohibits returns after closing, and there is no key drop. The car has to be checked in while the desk is staffed. Even a 4:10 departure from Roseville could put you there after 5:00 in traffic, so the $36.18 savings versus Alamo is not dependable.
Verify the late-return procedure on Enterprise and Alamo, not just their counter hours.

Enterprise at SMF lists the counter open until midnight Thursday and permits returns 24 hours a day. After the counter closes, follow the airport Rental Car Return signs, park in an Enterprise return lane, record fuel and mileage, and place the keys and agreement in the secure box at the return booth. The lane entry and key-drop time support the effective return time; the final receipt is issued after staff process the car. The consolidated rental-car shuttle runs continuously to the terminals.
And Alamo?

Alamo's SMF counter is open until 11:30 p.m. Thursday, and its return lanes are also open 24 hours. If no attendant is present, park in the marked Alamo lane, note fuel and mileage, and use the return-booth key box. The agreement may remain open in the system until morning, but the return-area timestamp is used when it is closed out. The terminal shuttle continues overnight. Neither viable quote charges an after-hours-return fee.
Are both rentals pay-later, and can I cancel without a penalty?

Yes. Both displayed rates are pay at pickup, with no prepayment. Enterprise allows cancellation before pickup without a fee. Alamo also shows no cancellation fee before the scheduled pickup time. A no-show can cause the reservation to be released, so the Tuesday flight number should be attached when one is reserved.
Now compare the actual driving. I do not want a vague statement that downtown is easier.

Downtown pattern: Tuesday SMF to the Hyatt is about 12 miles and 15-25 minutes after car pickup. Wednesday the inspection is a 6-8 minute walk from the hotel; downtown to Roseville at noon is about 20 miles and 25-40 minutes, and Roseville back downtown that evening is 30-50 minutes. Thursday downtown to Roseville is 25-45 minutes, followed by Roseville to SMF at 30-45 minutes. Expect roughly 90-100 total rental miles.
And from the Courtyard?

Roseville pattern: Tuesday SMF to the Courtyard is about 26 miles and 30-40 minutes. Wednesday Courtyard to downtown is normally 30-50 minutes, then downtown back to Roseville after noon is 25-40 minutes. Thursday the Courtyard-to-Roseville work drive is short, and Roseville to SMF remains 30-45 minutes. Expect about 100-110 rental miles. The meaningful penalty is Wednesday's early drive and parking search, not a large mileage difference.
Lay out Thursday from the last Roseville stop through boarding. Use the return procedure, not just airport arrival.

Leave the Roseville stop at 4:10 p.m. Allow 30-45 minutes to the SMF rental facility, putting you there around 4:40-4:55, with 5:05 as the traffic-buffer target. Allow 5-10 minutes to refuel nearby only if needed, 5 minutes to photograph the fuel gauge and mileage and complete the return, 10-15 minutes for the shuttle, and about 5 minutes to reach the security entrance. That places you at the terminal around 5:05-5:25 for the 6:20 p.m. nonstop. If you leave Roseville after 4:25, use the 24-hour return lane immediately rather than waiting for a staffed receipt.
Choose between them. I care about making the inspection, but $158 is enough that the difference needs to be real.

Choose the Courtyard Roseville Galleria Mall with Alamo. The $158.14 savings is real after taxes, parking, rental fees, downtown parking, and fuel. To protect the 10:30 inspection, leave the Courtyard by 9:15 Wednesday; that provides 75 minutes for a drive normally estimated at 30-50 minutes plus garage entry and the walk to the site. The Hyatt buys a simpler morning, but not enough practical time to justify the added cost given that departure buffer.
Keep that as the selected hotel and car arrangement, but leave everything unbooked. Retain the Hyatt-Enterprise combination as the fallback and the Thursday timing.

Saved without booking. Selected arrangement: Courtyard Roseville Galleria Mall for Tuesday and Wednesday nights at $363.46 including estimated room tax and free parking, plus the Alamo standard car at $197.48 including taxes and airport fees, $20 downtown parking, and $29 estimated fuel. Local total is $609.94; with the $618 nonstop flight pattern, estimated trip total is $1,227.94. Leave the Courtyard by 9:15 a.m. Wednesday and Roseville by 4:10 p.m. Thursday. Fallback: Hyatt Regency Sacramento with Enterprise, $768.08 locally and $1,386.08 including airfare. Both rentals support 24-hour returns; Ace is excluded because its 5:00 p.m. closing has no after-hours return. Nothing has been booked.
